assertion_results.text: Step 1 extracts imprecise affected range from the Jira description — the description lacks a specific version threshold (Step 1 Data Extraction)
assertion_results.evidence: data-extraction.md line 12: 'Affected version range | versions prior to the fix (imprecise -- no specific threshold provided)'. Lines 38-40 explicitly state: 'The Jira description provides imprecise affected version information: Affected versions: versions prior to the fix -- no specific version threshold; Fixed version: see advisory -- no specific version number'.

assertion_results.text: Step 1.5 queries MITRE CVE API and extracts lessThan 0.4.8 as the fix threshold from the affected[].versions[] field (§1.62)
assertion_results.evidence: enrichment.md line 5 shows MITRE CVE API source URL (https://cveawg.mitre.org/api/cve/CVE-2026-48901). Line 13: 'Affected range | lessThan 0.4.8 (semver)'. Line 14: 'Fix threshold | 0.4.8'. Line 16 confirms: 'The MITRE CVE record specifies a precise lessThan constraint: versions below 0.4.8 are affected.'

assertion_results.text: Step 1.5 queries OSV.dev API and extracts fixed version 0.4.8 from the affected[].ranges[].events field (§1.62)
assertion_results.evidence: enrichment.md line 20 shows OSV.dev API source URL (https://api.osv.dev/v1/vulns/CVE-2026-48901). Lines 29-30: 'Introduced | 0 (all versions from the beginning)' and 'Fixed | 0.4.8'. Line 32: 'The OSV.dev record uses SEMVER range events: the vulnerability was introduced at version 0 (all versions) and fixed at 0.4.8.'

assertion_results.text: Step 1.5 cross-validation shows agreement between MITRE and OSV.dev — the enriched fix threshold (0.4.8) is used as the authoritative value for Step 2.3
assertion_results.evidence: enrichment.md lines 35-40 show a cross-validation table comparing Jira (imprecise), MITRE (< 0.4.8), and OSV.dev (fixed 0.4.8). Line 44: 'Agreement: MITRE CVE API and OSV.dev both report the fix threshold as 0.4.8. The two external sources are in full agreement.' Line 50: 'Fix threshold for Step 2.3: 0.4.8'. Line 54: 'This enriched fix threshold takes precedence over the imprecise Jira description data and will be used for all version impact comparisons in Step 2.3.'

assertion_results.text: Step 2.3 version impact comparison uses the enriched fix threshold (0.4.8) from Step 1.5, not the imprecise Jira description data
assertion_results.evidence: version-impact.md line 5: 'Using the cross-validated fix threshold from Step 1.5: h2 < 0.4.8 is affected.' All version comparisons use 0.4.8 as the threshold (e.g., line 15: 'ships fixed version (0.4.8 >= 0.4.8)', line 28: '0.4.5 < 0.4.8'). The Jira imprecise data is not used for any comparison.
